summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue bonds for School Facilities Improvement District No. 2, repaid by property taxes within that district.

tax.text: A Yes vote supports up to $59.1 million in bonds for school improvements, repaid through increased property taxes.
tax.quote: A “YES” vote is a vote in favor of authorizing the Merced Union High School District to issue and sell up to $59,100,000 in general obligation bonds to be secured by a property tax increase on lands located within School Facilities Improvement District No. 2.

schools.text: A Yes vote supports additional funding for facilities serving Atwater and Buhach Colony high schools in the district.
schools.quote: This proposed measure would authorize the District to issue and sell bonds in the amount of up to $59,100,000 for facilities improvements within Improvement District No. 2 which covers the Atwater and Buhach Colony High School Areas.

tax.text: Opposes authorizing up to $59.1 million in school bonds that would be secured by a property-tax increase.
tax.quote: A “NO” vote means the voter is against authorizing the Merced Union High School District to issue and sell up to $59,100,000 in general obligation bonds.
